Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Aged above 60
  -  Confirmed literacy o Diagnosed with mild cognitive impairment  [AND] by International Working Group on Mild Cognitive Impairment and Clinical Dementia Rating(CDR) of 0 or 0

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Evidence of delirium, [OR]  confusion
  -  Any neurological conditions causing cognitive decline such as Parkinson's disease, brain hemorrhage, brain tumor, [OR]  normal pressure hydrocephalus
  -  Evidence of severe cerebrovascular pathology
  -  Presence of depressive symptoms that could influence cognitive function
  -  Presence of medical comorbidities that could result in any difficulties in study participation
